0.EN: HMM?! Sorry, sir, may I see thy pendant...?

1.EN:
Egad! This is... the bloodstone from "Castle Symphony"...?! 
Never has official merchandise of it ever been created...

2.EN:
I had never imagined I would ever see something
that looks exactly like it! This is so, very, RARE...!

3.EN:
Ngh... I want it... I want it so badly...!!
Sir! Wouldst thou be willing to trade it with me?!

4.EN:
In exchange, I offer thee my family heirloom...
A life-size figure from "Is the Order a Little Sister"!

6.EN:
HUZZAHHHH! The trade has been made!
Then may I have the pendant?

7.EN:
You give the otaku the pendant, and he tells you
the life-size figure will be mailed your apartment at a later date.

8.EN: (No, I can't do that. I have to give it back to that girl.)

9.EN:
ARGH! I am utterly vexed!
It must be an extremely important trinket!

10.EN: You put away the pendant and leave the shop.

11.EN: Welcome! We have something special on sale today!

12.EN:
It's a life-size figure from "Is the Order a Little Sister?"!
Now at a special, extra-low price of 70,000 yen!

13.EN:
(70,000 yen... That's probably much cheaper than what it usually goes for,
but it's still not something I can fork out willy-nilly...)

16.EN:
You purchased the life-size "Is the Order a Little Sister"? figure.
It will be mailed to your apartment at a later date.

17.EN: (I can't, I don't have enough money...)

18.EN:
I see... This is a limited offer for today only,
so if you want it, don't miss your chance!

19.EN:
Nyeheheh, the bloodstone's bewitching glimmer... How stunning...
To think I would come upon something so rare!

21.EN:
(I gave it up even though I found it on the street.
It's too late to regret it, but I still feel kinda bad...)

23.EN:
Nay, nay! I cannot give it to thee... Unless thou trades me
a life-size figure of Is the Order a Little Sister? for it!

24.EN: Aye, let us trade:option5;Nay, I will not trade:option6

25.EN:
HUH?! Dost thou truly have it...?!
Very well, I am a man of my word. This pendant belongs to thee!

26.EN:
You give up your ownership of the life-size figure
and trade back the pendant.

27.EN: (...No way. I'm not buying it back for more than I sold it for!)

28.EN: (A life-size figure... I wonder if they have one on sale here.)

29.EN: Augh, all of my favorite series are attacking me from all sides...!

30.EN: "Don't spend your lunch money on merch again, okay?"

32.EN:
Actually, I've just started an "oshi fund."
I glued a picture of my favorite maid character onto a piggy bank...

33.EN:
And I've written this story in my head that she's saving money
to buy her lady—that's me—a present! It's working wonders!

34.EN: Why don't you try it too, Manager?

35.EN:
YOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!
I finally got my hands on ancient scriptures!

36.EN: Wait, that's...! That's my family's secret scroll!

38.EN: Don't tell me... Are you planning to kill and loot me for these scrolls...?!

39.EN:
Nooo no no, nothin' of the sort.
It's just that... those are really important to me.

40.EN:
Huh! Well, it's hard to turn down an offer from a cute girl...
But I'm gonna stand my ground! I'm not giving 'em to you!

41.EN:
One's for keeping, and one's for reference.
I was asked to get them as props for cosplay!

43.EN:
Then at least offer something in return! No handouts here!
I need reference photos for a Japanese-style cosplay, and STAT!

44.EN: What do ya reckon we should show him in exchange?

45.EN: A real katana:option7;A real shrine maiden uniform:option8;A real ghost:option9

46.EN:
A katana, huh... I think they're cool too,
but I'm afraid I don't have a real one lyin' around...

47.EN: (That's a shame... What else could we show him?)

48.EN: Ain'tcha the only one who could see the ghost, though...?

49.EN: (Oh, right... What else could we show him?)

50.EN: "You know... This person right here is actually a real life shrine maiden."

51.EN:
Wait, HUHHHHHH?! A REAL shrine maiden?
In the flesh? True story not clickbait?!?!

52.EN:
As long as ya promise not to put 'em on the internet,
I don't mind ya takin' a couple pictures. C'mon, let's go to the shrine!

53.EN:
A campaign? I'll go ask our manager,
but I'm pretty sure we can join.

56.EN:
Oh, thank you! Then I'll contact you again
once I've gotten the confirmation.

57.EN:
A tie-in with THE anime store of Electric Street...
This campaign is going to be amazing!

58.EN: These days, I see merchandise of retro games more often.

59.EN: I respect their keen eye for the artifacts of old.

61.EN: What an immaculate and fair gothic lolita maiden!

62.EN:
What character might thou be cosplaying?!
May I take a photo...?!

65.EN: "Please calm down. She's not a cosplayer."

66.EN:
Ohhh... My apologies.
She looks as if she hails from the world of Castle Symphony,
thus I could hardly conceal my excitement.

67.EN: It's fine. I shall take that as a compliment.

68.EN:
Good job, my familiar.
...Thank you for saving me.

69.EN:
Ugh, what are you just standing there for?!
Let's get out of here!

70.EN:
Favna grabs you by the arm
and you hurriedly run away...

71.EN:
Secondhand doujinshi line the shelves.
Among them, you spot a doujinshi by Holy Hanpen...
who you know better as Honoka. It goes for quite a high price.

72.EN:
"Why are you a doujin artist, Honoka?
You don't seem like the type to get really invested in a show."

73.EN:
Yeah, I figured you'd think so.
Actually, there's a reason for that...

74.EN:
My dream is to draw for somethin' niche with a tiny fandom
and really dig deep into somethin' niche within that niche.

75.EN:
But whenever I make a doujinshi,
folks come crashin' in and livenin' up the place...

76.EN:
Popular fandoms just feel worse to be in for some reason,
so I move on to somethin' else, and then... it just happens all over again.

77.EN:
"Sounds to me that your art has the power
to promote and uplift hidden gems."

78.EN:
(But I understand not liking being influenced by everyone else's opinion...
I guess being popular has its downsides too.)

79.EN: "I hope you can find a fandom where you can create freely."

80.EN:
Thanks. I'll keep supportin' the media I've gotten into
over the years and try to find somethin' at my own pace.

81.EN:
To enter the Adventurer's Tavern, thou must have a Rainbow Controller!
In order to acquire one, thou shall bring to me these items three!

82.EN: The Sun Hard Drive, Raincloud Joystick, and Dragon Badge!

83.EN: Where could they possibly be... Alas!
